fields.title: Fields
fields.list_tooltip: Check fields to see their data, export or delete them. Click a name to zoom to it.
fields.empty: No fields yet. Click “Draw field” under the map to mark your first one.
fields.hint: Click to add points. Double-click, right-click or click the first point to finish (3 points minimum). Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
fields.error_duplicate: There is already a field called “{name}”.
fields.remove_many_confirm: Delete these {count} fields? This cannot be undone.

tools.title: Tools
fields.data_hint: Preloaded from satellite and public data. Replace a value if you have a more exact one.
data.legend: Grey values are preloaded; green bold ones were edited by you.

analysis.vegetation.title: Vegetation vigour (NDVI)
analysis.vegetation.description: How green and productive the field has been, month by month, and which zones are weaker.
analysis.vegetation.summary: Mean NDVI of {mean} over the last two years. On the map, weaker zones are brown.
analysis.vegetation.r.zones: Visit the weakest zones (NDVI {value}) and look for pests, waterlogging or compaction.
analysis.vegetation.r.soil_test: Take soil samples from a weak and a strong zone to compare nutrients.
analysis.vegetation.r.cover: Consider a cover crop after harvest to protect the soil.
analysis.vegetation.r.decline: Vigour fell {change} % from last year: review fertilisation and irrigation.
analysis.frost.title: Frost risk
analysis.frost.description: Minimum temperatures and the months when frost can damage crops.
analysis.frost.summary: About {days} frost days last year; {month} is the riskiest month.
analysis.frost.r.sensitive: Keep fruit trees and vegetables from flowering in the coldest months.
analysis.frost.r.protection: Plan frost protection (anti-frost irrigation, covers) for cold nights.
analysis.water.title: Water balance
analysis.water.description: Rain against the water crops use (evapotranspiration): when the field lacks water.
analysis.water.summary: The field lacked about {mm} mm of water over {months} months last year.
analysis.water.r.irrigation: Plan about {mm} mm of irrigation for the dry season.
analysis.water.r.crops: Prefer drought-tolerant crops or varieties for the dry season.
analysis.water.r.mulch: Use mulch or no-till to keep soil moisture.
analysis.heat.title: Heat stress
analysis.heat.description: Maximum temperatures and the days that are too hot for crops.
analysis.heat.summary: About {days} days last year were hot enough to stress crops.
analysis.heat.r.flowering: Avoid flowering in {month}: plan sowing so it happens before or after.
analysis.heat.r.irrigation_time: Irrigate early in the morning on hot days.
analysis.rotation.title: Crop rotation
analysis.rotation.description: Suggests which crops to grow in the next three seasons, using the other analyses and the soil.
analysis.rotation.summary: Start with {first}; the plan fits this field at {score} %.
analysis.rotation.r.avoid: Do not grow {crop} two seasons in a row on this field.
